protocol.title: Protocols

protocol.guardTitle: Hard leakage-prevention rules (enforced by the engine / covered by tests)
protocol.guard1: Any node that estimates parameters (centering, CSP, standardization, Riemann reference matrices) may only fit on training folds.
protocol.guard2: FitContext carries only training-fold indices and trial_ids; test-fold labels never enter fit.
protocol.guard3: Overlapping train/test indices raise an error; within-subject protocols reject multi-subject input.
protocol.guard4: The same seed yields fully reproducible splits, each with its own signature for caching and auditing.

xai.title: Explainability
xai.description: Open the model on one split: intrinsic parameters, channel × time occlusion, band ablation, gradient attribution and a knowledge audit — all fitted on the training fold only, with faithfulness and stability checks.
